RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  December 13, 2010/Agrahayana 22, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Corporate Affairs; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and
Renewable Energy; Power; Statistics and Programme
Implementation; Tribal Affairs; Women
and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
146
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Carbon emissions
*461. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the country is the third
largest contributor to the world carbon
emissions;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the names of the countries which are the
largest contributors to carbon emissions in
percentage terms;
(c) the extent to which the above
position has affected India's position on
climate change negotiations held recently
in Tianjin, China and is likely to affect
the future international negotiations;
and
(d) what is the action plan of
Government for effective emission cut and
simultaneously maintaining balance with
the economic growth of the country?
Allocation for the Tribal Building
Construction Scheme
†*462. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the budget allocated
for the Tribal Building Construction
Scheme during the years 2008-09 and
2009-10; and
(b) the details of the budget allocated
for research and training programme being
run in the field of anthropology for socio-
economic development of tribal population
of the country during the above period?
Environmental clearance to Navi
Mumbai Airport Project
*463. SHRI GOVINDRAO ADIK: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has issued all

147
environmental clearances for the early
completion of Navi Mumbai Airport
Project; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and on what
conditions?
Exploitation of women
*464. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: W ill the Minister
of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for increase in the
number of cases of sexual harassment in
urban areas, exploitation of women in
various professions and rape cases in rural
and urban areas; and
(b) the preventive and punitive  actions
proposed by the Ministry to protect the
victims and punish the guilty?
Setting up of Mega Food Parks
*465. SHRI NAND KUMAR SAI: Will
the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
set up five more Mega Food Parks under
the Infrastructure Development Scheme in
addition to the ten ongoing projects in the
country;
(b) if so, the details in this regard,
location-wise;
(c) the details of the criteria fixed for
selection of location for setting up of such
Parks;
(d) the grant likely to be provided by
Government to each of these Parks; and
(e) the details of the financial outcomes
likely to be generated by each of these
Parks?
Dedicated TV channel for farmers
*466. SHRIMATI KANIMOZHI: Will
the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
come up with a 24x7 television channel
dedicated to rural India, especially the
farmers;
(b) if so, by when it is proposed to be
launched;
(c) whether the channel would be
available in different languages to help the
farmers of different regions of the country;
and
(d) whether Government is concerned
about the lack of access to television sets
among rural population and what can be
done to address this situation?
Coal-based UMPPs
*467. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) the position as on 1 December, 2010
with regard to the setting up of coal-based
Ultra Mega Power Projects (UMPPs)
indicating the selection of sites, holding of
auctions for the selection of private parties
for their commissioning etc.; and
(b) by when the entire process for the
commissioning of the proposed UMPPs
is likely to be completed, leading to power
generation and its distribution to various
States and entities, etc. in each case?
GMDC's mining proposal
*468. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Gujarat has recommended

148
a proposal for prior approval of the Central
Government for Gujarat Mineral
Development Corporation ( GMDC's)
mining lease application for the lignite bearing
area of 3,319 hectare in district Kutch,
Gujarat; and
(b) if so,  by when the request of the
State Government is likely to be given prior
approval for the purpose?
Discriminatory provisions in CZR
*469. SHRI K.N. BALAGOPAL: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Coastal Zone
Regulation (CZR) gives more freedom for
construction in city corporation areas/metro
areas than in rural areas;
(b) what is the logic for liberal attitude
for construction in metro areas and whether
Government would re-examine the present
policy;
(c) whether the cases of violation of
CZR have increased in city corporation
areas; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Basic facilities in Anganwadi and Mini-
Anganwadi Centres in Tamil Nadu
*470. SHRIMATI JAYANTHI
NATARAJAN: Will the Minister of
WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Anganwadi and Mini-
Anganwadi Centres which are functional
in Tamil Nadu as on date, district-wise;
(b) how many of them are having basic
facilities like drinking water, toilets,
buildings, kitchen, etc.; and
(c) what steps Government proposes
to take to provide basic facilities in all the
centres of the State?
Outsourcing of CWG coverage
*471. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: W ill the
Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether any part of the coverage of
Commonwealth Games (CWG) had been
outsourced;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the amount paid to the agencies for
the outsourcing?
Food processing facilities
*472. DR. GY AN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether India's present level of food
processing is extremely low and if so, the
details thereof and how much food is
wasted due to lack of food processing
facilities;
(b) whether India's export of processed
food in global trade is extremely poor;
(c) how India compares with
neighbouring/developed countries;
(d) the achievements made during the
last three years;
(e) the steps taken by Government to
improve the situation; and
(f) where does Rajasthan stand in food
processing facilities?
Concerns on biofuels
*473. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI:
Will the Minister of NEW AND
RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of land diverted, in
hectares, for production of biofuels, State-
wise;

149
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether  the Ministry has carried
out any feasibility study on biofuels in the
country and on the projection of demand
in future; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Improvement of sanctuaries and parks
in Andhra Pradesh
*474. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the funds sought by the Andhra
Pradesh Government for improvement of
various sanctuaries and game parks during
the year 2010-2011;
(b) the funds allocated to the State for
such purposes during that period;
(c) the specific funds sought and given
for Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary during the
last two years;
(d) what measures Government would
initiate to protect the flora and fauna of the
Coringa Sanctuary and of the adjacent
Kolleru Lake in the State; and
(e) the measures proposed to send
teams to visit these areas and also the vast
mangrove forests at the river Godavari
delta?
Coverage of ICDS
*475. DR. JANARDHAN
WAGHMARE: Will the Minister of
WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether most of the children are out
of the ambit of the Integrated Child
Development Services (ICDS) Scheme and
it has failed to curb malnutrition;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has any plans
to revitalize this scheme;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government has received
complaints regarding supply of poor quality
of nutrition in Anganwadi Centres; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Surrendering of coal blocks by RINL
*476. SHRI PRAKASH JAV ADEKAR:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Rashtriya Ispat Nigam
Limited (RINL) has surrendered the
allocated coal blocks of Mahal and
Tenughat-Jhirki;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the action Government is proposing
in this regard?
Use of EVMs
†*477. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) the annual expenditure incurred by
the Election Commission of India on the
maintenance of Electronic V oting Machines
(EVMs);
(b) wehther it is not possible to use
EVMs if the number of candidates
contesting the elections is more than 64;
(c) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(d) whether there is any proposal for
changing the design/re-manufacturing of
EVMs to tackle such possibilities; and
(e) if so, the steps being taken to ensure
that EVMs pass the criteria and they
cannot be tampered with?

150
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 7th December, 2010 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 16, 1932 (Saka)
Development of forest infrastructure
*478. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: W ill the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government has
announced a plan for developing forest
infrastructure across the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the State Governments have
been asked to provide assistance in
developing forest infrastructure; and
(d) if so, by when the task of providing
infrastructure in forests is likely to be
completed?
Special dispensation to ecologically
sensitive areas
*479. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the details regarding introduction of
special dispensation to ecologically
sensitive areas, State-wise;
(b) whether such privileges would be
extended to other parts of the country; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Solar power projects to earn carbon
credits
*480. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of NEW AND
RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether climate change firm
'Emergent V entures International' has
launched an initiative to aggregate solar
power projects and help them earn carbon
credits from the UN Clean Development
Mechanism (CDM) that aims to reduce
emission through deployment of clean
technologies;
(b) if so, whether talks with some 40
project developers are going on to enroll
them in their initiative;
(c) whether registration, auditing and
consultation cost of single CDM project
could range between ` 20-50 lakh,
irrespective of the size  of the project; and
(d) if so, the  total number of solar units
that would be set up under this programme?

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Coal : 468, 476
Corporate Affairs : —
Development of North Eastern Region : —
Environment and Forests : 461, 463, 469, 474, 478, 479,
Food Processing Industries : 465, 472,
Information and Broadcasting : 466, 471,
Law and Justice : 477,
Mines : —
Minority Affairs : —
New and Renewable Energy : 473, 480,
Power : 467,
Statistics and Programme Implementation : —
Tribal Affairs : 462,
Women and Child Development : 464, 470, 475.
GMGIPMRND—5778RS—07.12.2010.
